ipa.financial_contracts.fx_option.PricingParameters

API endpoint for Financial Contract analytics, that returns calculations relevant to each contract type.

Available as lseg.data.content.ipa.financial_contracts.fx_option.PricingParameters.

Syntax

PricingParameters(
    *,
    atm_volatility_object: BidAskMid | None = None,
    butterfly10_d_object: BidAskMid | None = None,
    butterfly25_d_object: BidAskMid | None = None,
    cutoff_time: str | None = None,
    cutoff_time_zone: str | None = None,
    domestic_deposit_rate_percent_object: BidAskMid | None = None,
    foreign_deposit_rate_percent_object: BidAskMid | None = None,
    forward_points_object: BidAskMid | None = None,
    fx_spot_object: BidAskMid | None = None,
    fx_swap_calculation_method: FxSwapCalculationMethod | str = None,
    implied_volatility_object: BidAskMid | None = None,
    market_data_date: str | None = None,
    market_value_in_deal_ccy: float | None = None,
    price_side: PriceSide | str = None,
    pricing_model_type: PricingModelType | str = None,
    report_ccy: str | None = None,
    report_ccy_rate: float | None = None,
    risk_reversal10_d_object: BidAskMid | None = None,
    risk_reversal25_d_object: BidAskMid | None = None,
    simulate_exercise: bool | None = None,
    valuation_date: str | None = None,
    volatility_model: VolatilityModel | str = None,
) -> None

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
atm_volatility_object BidAskMid | None No None
butterfly10_d_object BidAskMid | None No None
butterfly25_d_object BidAskMid | None No None
cutoff_time str | None No None The cutoff time
cutoff_time_zone str | None No None The cutoff time zone
domestic_deposit_rate_percent_object BidAskMid | None No None
foreign_deposit_rate_percent_object BidAskMid | None No None
forward_points_object BidAskMid | None No None
fx_spot_object BidAskMid | None No None
fx_swap_calculation_method FxSwapCalculationMethod | str No None The method used to calculate an outright price or deposit rates.
implied_volatility_object BidAskMid | None No None
market_data_date str | None No None The date at which the market data is retrieved. the value is expressed in iso 8601 format: yyyy-mm-ddt[hh]:[mm]:[ss]z (e.g., '2021-01-01t00:00:00z'). it should be less or equal tovaluationdate). optional. by default,marketdatadateisvaluationdateor today.
market_value_in_deal_ccy float | None No None The market value (premium) of the instrument. the value is expressed in the deal currency. it is used to define optionprice and compute volatilitypercent. if marketvalueindealccy is defined, optionpriceside and volatilitypercent are not taken into account; marketvalueindealccy and marketvalueinreportccy cannot be overriden at a time. optional. by default, it is equal to optionprice for listed options or computed from volatilitypercent for otc options.
price_side PriceSide | str No None The quoted price side of the instrument.
pricing_model_type PricingModelType | str No None The model type of the option pricing. Optional. the default value depends on the option type.
report_ccy str | None No None The reporting currency code, expressed in iso 4217 alphabetical format (e.g., 'usd'). it is set for the fields ending with 'xxxinreportccy'. optional. the default value is the notional currency.
report_ccy_rate float | None No None The rate of the reporting currency against the option currency. it can be used to calculate optionprice and marketvalueindealccy if marketvalueinreportccy is defined. optional.by default, it is retrieved from the market data.
risk_reversal10_d_object BidAskMid | None No None
risk_reversal25_d_object BidAskMid | None No None
simulate_exercise bool | None No None Tells if payoff-linked cashflow should be returned. possible values:
- true
- false
valuation_date str | None No None The date at which the instrument is valued. the value is expressed in iso 8601 format: yyyy-mm-ddt[hh]:[mm]:[ss]z (e.g., '2021-01-01t00:00:00z'). by default, marketdatadate is used. if marketdatadate is not specified, the default value is today.
volatility_model VolatilityModel | str No None The model used to build the volatility surface. the possible values are:
- sabr,
- cubicspline,
- svi,
- twinlognormal,
- vannavolga10d,
- vannavolga25d.
